solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Microsoft Word is a graphical word processing program that users can type with.
 
• It is made by Microsoft.
 
• Its purpose is to allow users to type and save documents.
 
• Simple steps to open MS Word on the computer are:
 
 
• Start → All Programs → MS Office → MS Word.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first version of Microsoft Word was developed by Charles Simonyi and Richard Brodie.
 
• The first Word version, Word 1.0, was released in October 1983.
 
• Then it was renamed to Word 95 and Word 97, Word 2000, and Word for Office XP.
 
• Other Windows versions are:-
 
 
• Word 2007
 
• Word 2010
 
• Word 2013
 
• Word 2016
 
• And most recently, Word for Office 3
